description: This PHP file defines a controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin dashboard extension, specifically handling chart visualization and configuration for the dashboard. It includes methods for rendering the chart configuration page, saving settings, generating chart data, and returning chart information via AJAX.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Controller class for managing OpenCart dashboard charts, including rendering configuration pages, saving settings, and providing chart data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the dashboard chart configuration page with relevant data and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of dashboard chart settings, returning JSON with success or error message.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the view for the dashboard chart information.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: Generates and returns JSON data for chart visualization, based on selected time range.
